title: NANSEN stack output progress
description: How far a method got writing a stack a chunk of frames at a time: <output file>.progress.json beside the output file, while it is written, and removed once it is complete. A run of the same method with the same inputs goes on from the first frame not done (dev's ImageStackProcessor), with the state saved here, and gives what a run that never stopped gives; with other inputs it starts over. A method that goes through the frames more than once writes the output in its last pass.

method.description: The method writing the output; another version starts over.

dtype.description: Its type, by NumPy's name (uint16, float32, bool).

inputs.description: What the run started from: the options, and the input stack's shape and dtype. A run from other inputs starts over.

pass.description: The pass through the frames under way, from 1.

framesDone.description: The first framesDone frames of the pass are done (and written, in the last pass); frames are done in order.

state.description: What the method needs to go on from there, by name: arrays, exactly.

dtype.description: NumPy's name of its type: float64, int32, ...

data.description: The base64 of its values, little-endian, in column-major order (as MATLAB keeps an array).
